question: What landing-page structure converts cold Meta/Facebook roofing-lead traffic best on mobile (Facebook in-app browser as primary surface) — specifically multi-step quiz funnels vs single-page forms vs calendar-first self-scheduling vs click-to-call — with measured benchmarks, and what door/above-the-fold and contact-step designs measurably raise form-start and completion rates?
subQuestions: Measured click-to-lead conversion benchmarks for roofing and home-services landing pages on COLD Facebook/Meta prospecting traffic, broken out by format (multi-step quiz, single-page form, calendar/self-scheduling, click-to-call) — from CRO case studies, Unbounce/Instapage-class benchmark reports, or home-services PPC agencies publishing client data

Above-the-fold 'door' design for the Facebook in-app mobile browser: headline patterns with A/B evidence (offer-framed vs question vs price-anchored vs no headline), and what measurably moves form-START rate

Multi-step funnel mechanics with data: optimal question count and order, where the contact-info ask sits (start/middle/end), phone-field friction and mitigations, effort cues like 'takes 30 seconds', progress indicators

Calendar-first / self-scheduling landing pages for home services: does direct appointment booking convert better or worse than quote-request forms on cold social traffic, and what are show rates for self-booked vs rep-scheduled appointments
Mobile and in-app-browser technical/UX factors with measured conversion impact: load time, native-feel styling that mimics Meta instant forms, sticky CTAs, tap-target size
Revealed preference: what landing-page structures do the highest-spending roofing/home-services Meta advertisers actually run right now
checklist: benchmarks table with real numbers (roofing or home-services, paid social)
show rates: self-booked vs rep-scheduled appointments
stopCondition: Each format-comparison verdict carries at least one source with actual numbers; the benchmarks table draws on 3+ independent sources; the calendar-first question is answered with data or explicitly marked evidence-thin.
context: Client runs $98/mo financing-framed roof-replacement ads (LEARN_MORE, 'schedule my free quote' painted CTA) to a 4-tap quiz -> calendar -> name/phone funnel styled like a Meta instant form. Click->form-start currently 5-7%; historical best full completion 9.1%. Live experiments: 4 door-headline/flow arms including calendar-first. Deliverable: benchmarks table + ranked keep/change/test recommendations mapped to this funnel + a specific calendar-first vs quiz-first verdict for cold roofing traffic.
